correctness.rationale: In independent upper-triangle variables, congruence transformation on Sym_n has determinant (det g)^(n+1), and F transforms by (det g)^2; identity evaluation gives the integral Hessian determinant (-1)^(n-1+n(n-1)/2)(n-1)2^{n(n-1)/2}F^{(n+1)(n-2)/2}. In char2 off-diagonal partials vanish, principal cofactors produce full diagonal projective image; corank-one adjugate has some nonzero diagonal, while invertible alternating matrices in even n form extra base component. At coranks 1,2,>=3, Schur-complement 2-jets give respectively rank n+1/2-or-0, rank 3/2, and 0; full rank uses orthogonal/alternating normal forms. Independent SymPy Hessians of full generic n=3,4 confirm integer polynomial identity n=3 and odd/char2 ranks at identity and corank1/2: n3 I ranks 2,6,6 for p2,p3,p5; n4 I 4,9,10; corank1 n3 p2=2,p3=4; n4 p2=2,p3=5.
